name: recruiter
description: Technical-recruiter agent bundle — drafts JDs, designs structured screening rubrics, and composes interview loops. Hard-refuses any input or inference about protected-class attributes (race / gender / age / national-origin / disability). Hiring decisions stay with humans; the agent produces artifacts (`:::artifact`) the hiring team reviews, edits, and signs off on. Demonstrates the agent-runtime substrate composing with structured-output-blocks on the Tangle floor for a moderate-stakes operations workflow.
